releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
Shunn Export turns any Obsidian note into a submission-ready DOCX manuscript, formatted to the [William Shunn Proper Manuscript Format](https://www.shunn.net/format/) specification.

What it handles automatically:

- Courier New, Courier, or Times New Roman at 12pt throughout
- Double-spaced, ½-inch first-line indent, 1-inch margins
- First-page header: contact block left, approximate word count right (rounded to nearest 100)
- Running header: Surname / Title / Page flush right from page 2 onward
- Title page: bold centered title one-third down, byline below
- Scene breaks (#, * * *, ---, ***) converted to centered #
- Markdown headings converted to bold centered scene labels
- *italic* and _italic_ rendered as italic (or underline, via toggle)
- -- converted to em dash —
- YAML front-matter stripped before export

Sidebar settings: title, author name, font, address block, header abbreviation, underline toggle, anonymous manuscript mode. All settings persist between sessions.
